recognize_zh: A、B 圖骨髓芽細胞具豐富嗜鹼性細胞質，內有淡灰藍色的圓形包涵體與細長的類 Auer 小體結構（紅箭頭）及空泡；C 圖 MPO 染色中細胞質為棕色陽性但包涵體不染色；D 圖 RT-PCR 膠體顯示病人與陽性對照同位置條帶，對應 t(8;21) 融合轉錄物。
features: Panels A-B: blasts with large nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing pale grey-blue round inclusions and elongated Auer rod-like structures (red arrows)
Several blasts show cytoplasmic vacuoles and occasional perinuclear pale zones
Panel C: MPO cytochemistry shows granular brown positivity in blast cytoplasm, while the inclusions and rod-like structures remain unstained (arrows)
Panel D: agarose gel with 50 bp and 100 bp ladders; no band in negative control, band in positive control and an identically sized band in the patient sample
A cell with an abnormally clumped/lobulated nucleus is present among the blasts (panel B)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin and moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm, many containing pale grey-blue round inclusions and elongated Auer rod-like structures, with scattered cytoplasmic vacuoles. Myeloperoxidase cytochemistry demonstrates granular positivity in the blast cytoplasm, but the inclusions and rod-like structures are MPO negative, unlike true Auer rods. RT-PCR shows a product in the patient sample comigrating with the positive control and absent in the negative control. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 containing unusual MPO-negative inclusions.

ddx.vs: Genuine Auer rods are fused primary granules and are strongly MPO positive, whereas these structures do not stain with MPO.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules are large azurophilic granules that are typically MPO positive, while these inclusions are pale and MPO negative.
APL shows heavily granular or bilobed promyelocytes with bundles of MPO-positive Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA rather than RUNX1::RUNX1T1.
Phagocytic inclusions are heterogeneous in shape and often within vacuoles, whereas these inclusions are uniform and occur across many leukemic blasts.
